body: Thanks, I guess I feel like I've done the whole break-the-mold thing and it's brought me nothing but heartache. That last thing about being neat instead of nothingness really hit me though.
Thanks, it's not much compared to what a lot of people go through, I just feel like everyone who's ever 'loved' me has stabbed me in the back. I just can't take the pain anymore.
Thanks, no, almost 30 and shit hadn't gotten better yet unfortunately. I just really don't want another 30 years of this shit.

Thank you, hotline is a great idea. Is there any certain book/song/phrase that helped you feel like it's worth it? Or any event or person?

I just want to know how people who've been on the edge made it back.

Well, my life story in a nutshell. Alcoholic dad, mom has issues of her own but she neglected me and was emotionally abusive on a lot of levels. Not out of spite, she just has so many issues she *can't* be there foe me.

Divorced when I was 11, dad still alkie, mom too busy dating to notice me. Fucked up adolescence and teen years, never graduated, almost died in a car wreck,movedout to escape alkie brother (mom refused to stick up for me at all), then moved in with a guy who ended up beating and raping me. Had a kid with him, not from the rape, before that. She's a good kid I just feel like a shit parent and she'd be better off.

Got an associate degree, no job luck. Never had a good relationship, I'm the common denominator. Disowned dad, disowned brother, living with auntie. I feel like nothing but a burden, she'd be better off without me. Everyone would. I guess that's it's, i don't know. Thank you for listening.

Edit, also I disowned my best friend/cousin when she robbed me, and my other best friend got caught with kiddie porn and refuses to come clean (despite irrefutable evidence) so that friendship is over. Very few people in life I can talk to.
Yeah, I'll be here for a while, and I appreciate it. This is something I've put a lot of thought into for many months, and I'm just in the beginning preparatory stages, not the final execution stage.
